subject.title: fix(brave): resolve env secret refs for search key

question: Should a configured-but-unavailable Brave SecretRef fail closed, or may Brave fall back to BRAVE_API_KEY for compatibility?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the runtime result for an existing configuration shape, and source inspection was unavailable to independently establish the intended shared resolver contract.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior so an explicit but unavailable SecretRef returns a missing-key error and never uses ambient credentials.

options.title: Preserve fallback
options.body: Use BRAVE_API_KEY when the configured SecretRef cannot resolve, preserving the previous ambient-credential behavior.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed behavior so an explicit but unavailable SecretRef returns a missing-key error and never uses ambient credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Only the PR author can be identified from the supplied evidence; current-main feature ownership could not be inspected.
